paragraphs: Rabbi Assi bar Chama: [Bava Kamma 93a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.93a.7). Guria bar Chama: [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.11). Ze’ira bar Chama: Yoma 78b as cited by Hyman.[^3]
Rabbi Chanina bar Chama, the well-known sage.
Rabbi Levi bar Chama: [Taanit 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.16a.6). Mar Ukva bar Chama: [Berakhot 44a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.44a.6).
Rabbi Pinchas bar Chama: [Bava Batra 116a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.116a.15). Rami bar Chama: [Berakhot 44a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.44a.6).[^2]

notes.text: This notice lists fourteen people with the patronymic bar Chama. It does not establish that all fourteen had one father. The inspected Berakhot 44a directly names Rami bar Chama and Mar Ukva bar Chama; no general family merger follows.

The linked Avodah Zarah passage gives Abba bar Chama reporting Zeiri through Rav Chisda. Shabbat gives the longer form Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa. Yerushalmi Bikkurim explicitly gives Rabbi Yaakov bar Chama in Rabbi Elazar’s name.

In [Yoma 78a:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.78a.9), Ze’ira bar Chama hosts sages including Rabbi Ami, Rabbi Assi and Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. He describes Yehoshua ben Levi’s practice of preparing a cloth for Yom Kippur and the Ninth of Av. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1153&lang=en) also gives 78a and corrects a report that called him the host of Resh Lakish.
